properties.name: ConstantAttenuation
properties.desc: Defines the constant light attenuation of the light.

properties.name: Direction
properties.desc: Defines the direction of the light by using a vector.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.desc: Turns on/off the use of the light.

properties.name: Intensity
properties.desc: Defines the light's intensity.

properties.name: LinearAttenuation
properties.desc: Defines the linear light attenuation of the light.

properties.name: Name
properties.desc: Defines the name of light.

properties.name: Position
properties.desc: Defines the position of the light in World coordinate system.

properties.name: QuadraticAttenuation
properties.desc: Defines the quadratic light attenuation of the light.

properties.name: SpotAngle
properties.desc: Defines the angle of the light if its type is spot.

properties.name: SpotExponent
properties.desc: Defines the exponent of the light if its type is spot.

properties.name: Type
properties.desc:
Defines the light type. 
See Light Constants for more information.

methods.name: getPoint
methods.desc:
Returns a point at a given index 
		 in the line.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.desc: Adds a new point to the line.

methods.name: removePoint
methods.desc:
Removes a point at a given index 
		 from the line.

methods.name: update
methods.desc: Updates the internal structure of the line.

properties.name: Points
properties.desc: Gets a list of all points in the line.

properties.name: PointCount
properties.desc: Gets the amount of points in the line.

methods.name: getLine
methods.desc:
Returns a line using the point at a given index 
		 since a point may belong to more than one line.

properties.name: LineCount
properties.desc: Gets the total number of lines using the point.

methods.name: createPoint
methods.desc:
Creates a new point in the set at a given vector 
		 or XYZ coordinates, and then returns the point; otherwise returns 
		 None.

methods.name: createLine
methods.desc: Creates a new line in the set, and then returns the new line.

methods.name: deleteLine
methods.desc:
Deletes a given line from the set 
		 or one at a given index.

methods.name: getLine
methods.desc: Gets a line in the set at a given index.

methods.name: update
methods.desc:
Updates the line set, thereby recalculating the bound box of 
		 the set.

properties.name: Lines
properties.desc: Gets a list of all lines in the set.

properties.name: Points
properties.desc: Gets a list of all points in the set.

properties.name: LineCount
properties.desc: Gets the amount of lines in the set.

properties.name: LineWidth
properties.desc: Defines the width (in pixels) of lines in the set.

properties.name: Ambient
properties.desc:
Defines a vector used for calculating the ambient value of 
		 material.

properties.name: ColorMask
properties.desc:
Defines the RGB/RGBA color mask used for rendering material. 
		 
		See Material 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: DepthComparison
properties.desc:
Controls the visibility of geometry assigned the material based 
		 on pixel depth (distance from camera) in comparison to a Z-axis 
		 buffer. 
		Depth comparison is important for defining 
		 how a material is rendered in terms of elevation and depth and 
		 its interference with other materials.
		See Material 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: Diffuse
properties.desc:
Defines a vector used for calculating diffuse reflection of 
		 light hitting material.

properties.name: LineStippling
properties.desc:
Turns on/off the use of stippling in the material to create 
		 light and dark shades based on point density.

properties.name: LineWidth
properties.desc: Defines the width of line primitives used for stippling.

properties.name: Name
properties.desc: Defines the name of material.

properties.name: Opacity
properties.desc: Defines the material's opacity, thereby its transparency.

properties.name: OpacityType
properties.desc:
Defines the opacity type used by material. 
		See Material 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: RenderOrder
properties.desc:
Defines the order in which geometry using this material is 
		 rendered in 3D world. 
		See Material 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: Shininess
properties.desc:
Defines the intensity of light reflected from material, thereby 
		 defining its luster.

properties.name: Specular
properties.desc:
Defines a vector used for calculating specular reflection of 
		 light hitting material.

properties.name: StipplingPattern
properties.desc:
Defines the stippling pattern of material based on the bits 
		 of an integer.

properties.name: StipplingScale
properties.desc:
Defines scale factor of the material's stippling pattern which, 
		 by default, is 1.

properties.name: Texture
properties.desc: Gets a bitmap defining the texture of material.

properties.name: TextureMapping
properties.desc:
Defines how the material's texture is projected or defined 
		 using coordinates. 
		See Material 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: N
methods.desc: Defines Normal vector that is unit vector in X-axis direction.

methods.name: O
methods.desc: Defines Orientation vector that is unit vector in Y-axis direction.

methods.name: A
methods.desc: Defines Approach vector that is unit vector in Z-axis direction.

methods.name: P
methods.desc: Defines Position vector.

methods.name: WPR
methods.desc: Defines roll, pitch and yaw angles.

methods.name: getAxisAngle
methods.desc:
Returns the orientation of the matrix as a rotation of its 
		 identity matrix about the axis defined by the XYZ values of the 
		 returned vector. 
		The W property of the returned vector is 
		 the rotation angle (in degrees).

methods.name: getEuler
methods.desc:
Returns the orientation of the matrix as a set of absolute 
		 rotations (in fixed coordinate system) around the Z-axis, followed 
		 by the Y-axis, and then again the Z-axis, in the form of a vector 
		 containing those angles (in degrees).

methods.name: getQuaternion
methods.desc:
Returns the orientation of the matrix as a quaternion in the 
		 form of a vector.

methods.name: getWPR
methods.desc:
Returns the orientation of the matrix as a set of relative 
		 rotations around ZYX axes, in that order, in the form of a vector 
		 containing those angles (in degrees).

methods.name: identity
methods.desc: Sets matrix to equal its identity.

methods.name: invert
methods.desc: Sets the matrix to equal its inverse.

methods.name: rotateAbsX
methods.desc: Rotates the matrix around X-axis in absolute coordinate system.

methods.name: rotateAbsY
methods.desc: Rotates the matrix around Y-axis in absolute coordinate system.

methods.name: rotateAbsZ
methods.desc: Rotates the matrix around Z-axis in absolute coordinate system.

methods.name: rotateAbsV
methods.desc:
Rotates the matrix around an axis defined by a given vector 
		 by a given angle in absolute coordinate system.

methods.name: rotateRelX
methods.desc:
Rotates the matrix around X-axis in coordinate system relative 
		 to matrix position.

methods.name: rotateRelY
methods.desc:
Rotate the matrix around Y-axis in coordinate system relative 
		 to matrix position.

methods.name: rotateRelZ
methods.desc:
Rotates the matrix around Z-axis in coordinate system relative 
		 to matrix position.

methods.name: rotateRelV
methods.desc:
Rotates the matrix around an axis defined by a given vector 
		 by a given angle in coordinate system relative to matrix position.

methods.name: scaleAbs
methods.desc: Scales the matrix in relation to 3D world origin.

methods.name: scaleRel
methods.desc: Scales the matrix in relation to matrix position.

methods.name: setAxisAngle
methods.desc:
Rotates the matrix around an axis. 
		The x, y and z arguments 
		 define a unit vector and direction of axis. The w 
		 argument defines the rotation (in degrees) around that axis.

methods.name: setEuler
methods.desc:
Sets the orientation of the matrix by executing a set of absolute 
		 rotations (in degrees) around Z-axis, followed by Y-axis, and 
		 then around Z-axis in fixed coordinate system.

methods.name: setIJK
methods.desc:
Sets the orientation of the matrix so that its Approach vector 
		 (Z-axis) is aligned with a vector defined by i, 
		 j and k 
		 arguments.

methods.name: setQuaternion
methods.desc:
Sets the orientation of the matrix by using a quaternion defined 
		 by four given arguments.

methods.name: setWPR
methods.desc:
Sets the orientation of the matrix by using roll, 
		 pitch and yaw 
		 arguments.

methods.name: translateAbs
methods.desc:
Translates the matrix position by a given offset (XYZ values) 
		 in reference (Parent) coordinate system. Parent can be for example 
		 the World or a Node.

methods.name: translateRel
methods.desc:
Translates the matrix position by a given offset (XYZ values) 
		 in Object coordinate system.

methods.name: uniform
methods.desc: Modifies the matrix to be orthogonal and contain no scaling.

properties.name: new
properties.desc: Creates a new vcMatrix object.

methods.name: signal
methods.desc:
Signals the current value of signal to all connected behaviors, 
		 thereby triggering the OnSignal event. 
		An optional value 
		 argument can be given to set the Value property of the signal.

properties.name: Value
properties.desc:
Defines the value of signal. 
		Setting this value does not trigger the 
		 OnSignal event unless you use the signal() method.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.desc:
Adds a new motion target to the interpolator using either the 
		 robot's current posture or given arguments. 
		If motiontype 
		 argument is VC_MOTIONTARGET_MT_LINEAR, speed 
		 argument defines CartesianSpeed (mm/s) property of motion target.
		If motiontype 
		 argument is VC_MOTIONTARGET_MT_JOINT, speed 
		 argument defines JointSpeedFactor (mm/s) property of motion target.
		See vcRslMotionStatement 
		 and vcMotionTarget for more information.

methods.name: getCycleTimeAtTarget
methods.desc:
Returns the cycle time of a motion target at a given index 
		 in interpolator's Targets property.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.desc: Returns an interpolated motion target based on a given cycletime.

properties.name: DefaultTargetMode
properties.desc:
Defines the relationship between motion targets and robot. 
See Motion Target Constants for more information.

properties.name: Targets
properties.desc: Lists all motion targets in the interpolator.

properties.name: Acceleration
properties.desc:
Defines rate of acceleration (mm/s^2) for components moving 
		 on path. 
		If zero, acceleration is not calculated.

properties.name: Accumulate
properties.desc:
Turns on/off pile-up of components moving on path. 
		If True, components on the path stop moving 
		 when they encounter a blocked component. If False, components 
		 on the path stop moving when a component is blocked from exiting 
		 the path.

properties.name: Deceleration
properties.desc:
Defines rate of deceleration (mm/s^2) for components moving 
		 on path. 
		If zero, deceleration is not calculated.

properties.name: DetailCurveMotion
properties.desc:
Turns on/off detailed movement 
		 of components to and from path, for example when moving from linear 
		 path to curved path. 
		If True, bound box of component is used 
		 to avoid intersecting with other components. This might create 
		 a gap between components, for example components that are cylindrical. 
		 This also decreases simulation performance.
		You can disable DetailCurveMotion if components 
		 are cylindrical or if a slight intersection between components 
		 when transferring from linear to curved path is not a concern.

properties.name: Direction
properties.desc:
Defines the direction components move on path, but only if 
		 the path supports two or more directions. 
		See Conveyor 
		 Direction Constants for more information.

properties.name: FastScheduling
properties.desc:
Turns on/off the optimization 
		 of moving components on the path. 
		If True, the path limits the amount of generated 
		 events, thereby improving simulation performance.
		If False, the path moves components at shorter 
		 increments, thereby increasing the amount of events and decreasing 
		 simulation performance.

properties.name: Interpolation
properties.desc:
Defines mode used by path to interpolate its waypoints set 
		 in Path property. 
		See Conveyor 
		 Interpolation Mode Constants for more information.

properties.name: Path
properties.desc:
Defines an ordered list of Frame features referenced as waypoints 
		 of path. 
		If set, path is calculated based on its 
		 interpolation mode.

properties.name: PathAxis
properties.desc:
Defines mode for calculating how much space a component occupies 
		 on path, thereby allowing the path to utilize its space and determine 
		 if one or more components are blocked if SpaceUtilization property 
		 is set to True. 
		See Path 
		 Axis Mode Constants for more information.

properties.name: PathLength
properties.desc:
Gets the length of path. That is, the distance from first to 
		 last waypoint along the path.

properties.name: RetainOffset
properties.desc:
Defines if a component entering, placed or grabbed by the path 
		 is snapped to and aligned with path's axis. 
		If True, a component retains its offset 
		 while moving on path. If False, component is snapped to nearest 
		 point on path and its origin is aligned with calculated path.

properties.name: SegmentSize
properties.desc:
Defines the size of segments when path uses segmentation to 
		 move components to and from different sections of the path. 
		If value is greater than zero, the number 
		 of path segments is calculated in order to determine the capacity 
		 of each segment based on total capacity of path. Therefore, components 
		 move on path based on the capacity of a proceeding segment.

properties.name: Sensors
properties.desc:
List of sensors connected to path, which must be either component 
		 path or process point type sensors.

properties.name: SpaceUtilization
properties.desc:
Defines if components accumulating on path are kept separate 
		 from one another and how new components enter path. 
		If False, components may overlap one another 
		 and/or pile up side by side, which might be useful if RetainOffset 
		 is set to True.

properties.name: Speed
properties.desc: Defines the speed (mm/s) of path.

properties.name: AccuracyMethod
properties.desc:
Defines the zone of accuracy type to use for the target, for 
		 example distance, time or velocity. 
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

properties.name: AccuracyValue
properties.desc: Defines the limit used in AccuracyMethod.

properties.name: Base
properties.desc: Defines the base frame used by robot for the statement.

properties.name: CycleTime
properties.desc:
Defines the total elapsed time (in seconds) for executing 
		 motion statement, which may scale speed and acceleration of joints.
		If zero, CycleTime is ignored.

properties.name: ExternalTCP
properties.desc:
Defines the interpolation mode for targeting motion. 
		0 = False
		Default setting that uses Base to Tool configuration; position 
		 created at tool frame.
		1 = True
		Interpolation from Tool to Base; position created at base frame.

properties.name: Tool
properties.desc: Defines the tool frame used by robot for the statement.

methods.name: getConfigWarning
methods.desc:
Tests a robot configuration for any potential issues associated 
		 with target. 
		The returned value indicates singularity 
		 (S), joint limits (J) and unreachable (U) errors using a format 
		 of SJU.
		0 = 000
		No errors.
		1 = 001
		Reachability error in robot.
		2 = 010
		One or more joints exceeding limits.
		3 = 011
		Reachability and joint limit errors.
		4 = 100
		Singularity detected, for example in articulated robot wrist.
		5 = 101
		Singularity and reachability errors.
		6 = 110
		Singularity and joint limit errors.
		7 = 111
		Singularity, joint limit and reachability errors.
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

methods.name: getConfigWarnings
methods.desc:
Tests all configurations in kinematic structure for potentials 
		 errors related to target. 
		See getConfigWarning() method for more information 
		 on possible returned values.

methods.name: getPositionerRootToPositionerFlange
methods.desc:
Returns the offset from robot positioner root node to its flange 
		 node.

methods.name: getRootNodeToPositionerRoot
methods.desc:
Returns the offset from root node to robot positioner root 
		 node.

methods.name: getRootNodeToRobotRoot
methods.desc: Returns the offset from root node to robot root node.

methods.name: getRobotRootToRobotFlange
methods.desc: Returns the offset from robot root node to robot flange node.

methods.name: getSimWorldToRootNode
methods.desc: Returns the offset from 3D world origin to root node.

methods.name: getSimWorldToRobotTool
methods.desc:
Returns the offset from 3D world origin to tool frame active 
		 in robot.

methods.name: getSimWorldToRobotWorld
methods.desc: Returns the offset from 3D world origin to Robot World Frame.

methods.name: getWorldToRootNode
methods.desc: Returns the offset from 3D world origin to root node. (Deprecated)

methods.name: getWorldToRobotTool
methods.desc:
Returns the offset from 3D world origin to tool frame active 
		 in robot. (Deprecated)

properties.name: AccuracyMethod
properties.desc:
Defines the zone of accuracy type to use for the target, for 
		 example distance, time or velocity. 
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

properties.name: AccuracyValue
properties.desc: Defines the limit used in AccuracyMethod.

properties.name: AngularSpeed
properties.desc:
Defines the rate of target rotation (degrees/s), which is only 
		 used for non-joint motions.

properties.name: BaseMatrix
properties.desc:
Defines a matrix referenced by the target as robot base frame. 
		 If set, this property overrides BaseName.

properties.name: BaseName
properties.desc: Defines base frame in robot controller referenced by the target.

properties.name: CartesianAcceleration
properties.desc:
Defines the maximum Cartesian acceleration (units/s^2) of linear 
		 motion to target.

properties.name: CartesianDeceleration
properties.desc:
Defines the maximum Cartesian deceleration (units/s^2) of linear 
		 motion to target.

properties.name: CartesianSpeed
properties.desc:
Defines the maximum Cartesian speed (units/s) of linear motion 
		 to target.

properties.name: ConfigCount
properties.desc: Gets the number of available configurations in robot.

properties.name: ConfigurationMode
properties.desc:
Defines the robot's joint configuration during linear interpolation, 
		 which can be fixed, an attempt to maintain current configuration 
		 or one interpolated using joint values. 
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

properties.name: JointSpeedFactor
properties.desc:
Defines the joint speed at the target, as a factor of maximum 
		 speed determined in robot controller.

properties.name: JointTurnMode
properties.desc:
Defines the turn mode for joints in the target. 
		The default mode is for joints to turn nearest 
		 within their set limits.
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

properties.name: JointValues
properties.desc:
Defines joints values of target if using joint interpolation. 
		 
		To read and write joint values, first get 
		 a handle for this property, edit the values of that handle, and 
		 then assign that handle as the value of this property.
		See Example. 
		 Edit joint values in motion target for more information.

properties.name: MotionType
properties.desc:
Defines the motion type of the target, which is either linear 
		 or point-to-point/joint. 
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

properties.name: OrientationInterpolationMode
properties.desc:
Defines the orientation interpolation mode for linear movement. 
		 
		See Orientation 
		 Interpolation Mode Constants for more information.

properties.name: PositionerIndex
properties.desc: Defines current positioner used by robot to reach target.

properties.name: RobotConfig
properties.desc:
Defines robot configuration at target, which is dependent on 
		 the kinematic structure.

properties.name: Target
properties.desc:
Defines position matrix of target relative to its base frame 
		 or matrix.

properties.name: TargetMode
properties.desc:
Defines how position matrix of target relates to robot. 
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

properties.name: ToolMatrix
properties.desc:
Defines a matrix referenced by the target as the robot tool 
		 frame. If set, this property overrides ToolName.

properties.name: ToolName
properties.desc: Defines tool frame in robot referenced by target.

properties.name: UseJoints
properties.desc:
Defines if JointValues property is used to define target or 
		 its Target property. That is, whether the target is defined using 
		 joint values or a position matrix that is used to calculate joint 
		 values. 
		If you set JointValues, this property is 
		 automaticaly set to True.
		If you set Target, this property is automatically 
		 set to False.

properties.name: FlowStep
properties.desc: Specifies ProcessFlowStep

properties.name: Group
properties.desc: Specifies ProcessGroup inside the FlowStep.

properties.name: ForceExactFlowStep
properties.desc:
Expansion into vcFeedOptionFlowInfo objects may result in multiple 
		 options with multiple FlowSteps (e.g., when given FlowStep is 
		 Optional). 
		Setting this to True will filter the results to contain only the 
		 given FlowStep.

properties.name: ForceExactProcessGroup
properties.desc:
Expansion into vcFeedOptionFlowInfo objects may result in multiple 
		 options with multiple ProcessGroups (e.g., when given FlowStep 
		 contains multiple ProcessGroups). 
		Setting this to True will filter the results to contain only the 
		 given ProcessGroup (based on GroupID).

methods.name: attach
methods.desc:
Attaches a given node. 
		The permanent argument is optional, 
		 and its value is set to True by default. If you set the value 
		 to False, the Save button in the Visual Components user 
		 interface will remain disabled when you attach the node.
		See Example. 
		 Attach a node to another node during a simulation for more 
		 information.

methods.name: createNode
methods.desc:
Creates a new child node of a given type 
		 and name for this node. 
		This cannot be used to create a new 3D world 
		 root node.
		See Node 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: createBehaviour
methods.desc:
Creates a new behavior of a given type 
		 and name in node. 
		See Behavior 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: delete
methods.desc:
Deletes the node. 
		Deletion will fail if method is called in 
		 Python Script contained in the node.

methods.name: findBehaviour
methods.desc:
Returns the first behavior matching a given name 
		 in node or in one of its child nodes; otherwise returns None.

methods.name: findBehavioursByType
methods.desc:
Returns a list of all behaviors matching a given type 
		 in node and all of its child nodes; otherwise returns an empty 
		 list. 
		See Behavior 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: findFeature
methods.desc:
Returns the first feature matching a given name 
		 in node or in one of its child nodes; otherwise returns None.

methods.name: findNode
methods.desc:
Returns the first child node matching a given name; 
		 otherwise returns None.

methods.name: getBehaviour
methods.desc:
Returns the first behavior matching a given name 
		 in node; otherwise returns None.

methods.name: getBehavioursByType
methods.desc:
Returns a list of all behaviors matching a given type in the 
		 node; otherwise returns an empty list. 
		See Behavior 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.desc:
Returns the first feature matching a given name 
		 in node; otherwise returns None.

methods.name: localToWorld
methods.desc:
Transforms the given matrix 
		 or vector 
		 from node's coordinate system to the world coordinate system 
		 and returns that with a new instance.

methods.name: measureDistance
methods.desc:
Returns the minimum distance 
		 between the geometry of this node and a node or a given list of 
		 nodes. Additional values returned are position vectors for the 
		 two closest points, point1 
		 and point2, as well as 
		 a direction vector indicating 
		 the distance and direction from those points. 
		  
		If no minimum distance found, returns None. 
		  
		Note: The returned vector is based in the coordinate 
		 system of the node calling this method.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.desc:
Rebuilds the geometry of node and its hierarchy by re-evaluating 
		 their feature trees. The hierarchy contains child components. 
		 
		Note: 
		 Try avoid using this method during a simulation.

methods.name: update
methods.desc:
Updates the node and its hierarchy. The hierarchy contains 
		 child components.

methods.name: worldToLocal
methods.desc:
Transforms the given matrix or vector from world 
		 coordinate system to the node's local coordinate system and returns 
		 with a new instance.

properties.name: Behaviours
properties.desc: Gets a list of all behaviors in node.

properties.name: BoundCenter
properties.desc:
Gets a vector from node origin to center of its geometry bound 
		 box.

properties.name: BoundDiagonal
properties.desc:
Gets a vector from center of node's geometry bound box to its 
		 upper corner using positive axis directions.

properties.name: ChildComponents
properties.desc:
Gets a list of all components attached to the node at any depth 
		 in structure.

properties.name: Children
properties.desc:
Gets a list of nodes attached to the node at first level. That 
		 is, the node is parent to those nodes.

properties.name: Component
properties.desc: Gets the component of node.

properties.name: ComponentChildren
properties.desc:
Gets a list of components attached to the node at first level. 
		 That is, the node is parent to those component root nodes.

properties.name: Dof
properties.desc:
Gets the degree-of-freedom (DOF) object that defines the joint 
		 properties of the node and its mechanism of movement. 
		If JointType is fixed, Dof will be assigned 
		 None.

properties.name: Geometry
properties.desc:
Gets the container of geometry in node. 
		Geometry in container is result of evaluating 
		 node's feature tree, but can be manually set.

properties.name: IgnoreEvents
properties.desc:
Defines if node ignores event passing in order to avoid the 
		 creation of cyclic calls.

properties.name: InverseWorldPositionMatrix
properties.desc:
Gets inverse of node's position matrix in World coordinate 
		 system. 
		Note: Using 
		 World matrix requires scene updating.

properties.name: JointExpression
properties.desc:
Defines an expression that when evaluated returns the joint 
		 definition of the node.
		(Deprecated) 
		 Use vcNode.Dof.Joint if joint type is custom.

properties.name: JointType
properties.desc:
Defines the joint type of the node. 
		See Joint 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: MaterialInheritance
properties.desc:
Defines the mode for managing NodeMaterial property. 
		For example, node material could override 
		 feature materials and child nodes.
		See Node 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: Name
properties.desc: Defines the node's name.

properties.name: NodeMaterial
properties.desc:
Defines the node's material. 
		This property is used with MaterialInheritance 
		 to define how the node's material is assigned to its features

		 to have the distribution use a stream for seeding a value and 
		 generating the same set of random numbers during a simulation. 
		 That is, if you reset and run a simulation you should expect the 
		 same values given in the previous simulation.

properties.name: Group
properties.desc:
Defines the group assignment of property. 
		Properties are ordered by groups, and a 
		 group number is automatically assigned at the time of creation. 
		 This order can be overridden to have properties come before or 
		 after one another when listed in the GUI.

properties.name: IgnoreEvents
properties.desc:
Defines if event passing is ignored by property, for example 
		 to avoid cyclic calls.

properties.name: IsVisible
properties.desc: Turns on/off the visibility of property in Properties panel.

properties.name: IsVisibleDesignTime
properties.desc:
Turns on/off the visibility of property in Component Cell Graph 
		 panel.

properties.name: IsDesignTime
properties.desc: Defines if property is used for component authoring.

properties.name: IsPersistent
properties.desc: Defines if property value is saved with component or layout.

properties.name: ListValueCount
properties.desc: Gets the number of values listed in property.

properties.name: ListValues
properties.desc: Gets a list of values for property.

properties.name: Magnitude
properties.desc:
Gets the conversion factor of unit assigned to property. 
		The conversion factor is used to convert 
		 the value of property to and from its canonical unit. For example, 
		 if the property has a Quantity of Distance with a Unit of millimeters 
		 (mm), the magnitude is 1. If Unit is meters (m), the magnitude 
		 is 1000.0.
		Note: You can 
		 use setUnitMagnitude() to change the unit of property based on 
		 the current unit group of its quantity. For example, a magnitude 
		 of 10 would most likely change the unit to centimeters (cm) if 
		 the quantity of property was Distance.

properties.name: MaxValue
properties.desc:
If property supports a limit constraint, defines maximum value 
		 of property.

properties.name: MinValue
properties.desc:
If property supports a limit constraint, defines the minimum 
		 value of property.

properties.name: Name
properties.desc: Defines the name of property.

properties.name: Quantity
properties.desc:
Defines the quantity of property. 
		Tip: You assign 
		 the quantity by name using a string, for example Distance, thereby 
		 the application will search for and assign a quantity matching 
		 that name.

properties.name: RandomStream
properties.desc:
If Distribution type property, defines a stream used for generating 
		 pseudo-random values. 
		Every layout has a RandomStreams layout 
		 item, which has a set of RandomSeedN properties where N is 0 to 
		 63, which contain the seed values for each stream.
		A random stream can be used in distribution 
		 function, for example normal(stream,u,s) 
		 in which stream is the index of stream 
		 in the layout to use, u is mean value 
		 and s is standard deviation.

properties.name: StepValues
properties.desc:
If property has a step constraint, defines a list of step values 
		 for property.

properties.name: SupportsTemplate
properties.desc: Indicates if property supports the use of a templates.

properties.name: Templates
properties.desc: Gets a list of templates in property.

properties.name: Type
properties.desc:
Gets the property type. 
		See Property 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: Unit
properties.desc:
Gets the unit of property. 
		Note: Use setUnitMagnitude() 
		 to change the unit of property. The magnitude should be the conversion 
		 factor of unit in the current unit group of quantity assigned 
		 to property.

properties.name: Value
properties.desc: Gets/Sets property value.

properties.name: WritableWhenConnected
properties.desc:
Defines if property value can be set when component of property 
		 is connected to another component via interface.

properties.name: WritableWhenDisconnected
properties.desc:
Defines if property value can be set when component of property 
		 is not connected to another component via interface.

properties.name: WritableWhenSimulating
properties.desc: Defines if property value can be set when a simulation is running.

properties.name: Properties
properties.desc: Gets a list of properties specific to list value.

properties.name: Template
properties.desc: Gets the name of template for list value.

Returns a forward kinematics matrix calculated for given 
		 joint values.

methods.desc: Returns the node containing the kinematics object.

methods.desc: Returns the simulation object.

methods.name: sasa
methods.desc:
Returns the angle (in radians) of a triangle based on two given 
		 sides and the angle between them. 
		 
		In this case, the third side of a triangle 
		 is calculated, and then used to calculate the angle between that 
		 side and the second side argument.

methods.name: sass
methods.desc:
Returns the side of a triangle based on two given sides and 
		 the angle between them.

methods.name: sssa
methods.desc:
Returns the angle (in radians) of a triangle based on three 
		 given sides. 
		In this case, returned angle is the angle 
		 opposite the first side argument.

properties.name: Application

properties.name: Simulation

properties.name: Script

Defines the executable Python code of kinematics object, thereby 
		 the custom kinematics of a vcKinObject 
		 object. 
		See Python 
		 Kinematics for more information.

methods.name: condition
methods.desc:
Runs a conditional test that stops process execution until 
		 a given function returns a True value. 
		The given function can either be a lambda 
		 function or one defined in Script.
		Evaluation of condition 
		 is done continuously.

methods.name: delay
methods.desc: Executes timed delay during process execution.

methods.name: evaluateCondition
methods.desc:
Triggers the evaluation of an active condition() or triggerCondition() 
		 function in the script.

methods.desc: Returns the application object.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.desc: Returns the component containing the process handler.

methods.name: getSimulation
methods.desc: Returns the simulation object.

methods.name: getTrigger

Returns the object triggering an event in Script; otherwise 
		 returns None. 
		This method is only useful in a condition 
		 function passed to condition() and triggerCondition() methods.

		 for example, is a signal or action connected to process handler.

methods.name: suspendRun
methods.desc: Stops the execution of an OnRun() function.

methods.name: triggerCondition
methods.desc:
Runs a conditional test, triggered during a simulation, that 
		 stops process execution until a given function returns a True 
		 value. 
		The given function can either be a lambda 
		 function or one defined in Script.
		Evaluation of condition is done each time 
		 a trigger of process handler occurs during a simulation.

properties.name: Icon
properties.desc:
Defines an icon for the process when referenced by a process 
		 statement in the GUI.

properties.name: Process
properties.desc: Defines the name and id of process.

properties.name: Script
properties.desc: Defines the executable Python code of process.

methods.name: workDone
methods.desc:
Notifies the Work statement that work has been done so the 
		 process can continue executing.

methods.name: RequestId
methods.desc:
Unique (within this transport controller) identifier 
				 of this work assignment.

methods.name: RequestingProcess
methods.desc: The process implementation that requested this work.

methods.name: ProcessTime
methods.desc:
A value that defines how long the work itself should 
				 take in seconds.

methods.name: ResourcePositionMatrix
methods.desc:
Position hint in world coordinates where the actual 
				 work is expected to happen.

methods.name: WorkPositionMatrix
methods.desc:
Position hint in world coordinates where the working 
				 resource is expected to be while doing the work.

properties.name: Icon
properties.desc:
The icon file used to represent this transport controller 
		 in UI.
		Defines either filesystem path to the SVG image file or an SVG 
		 path data. Both relative and absolute paths with/without .svg 
		 extension are allowed. Relative paths are relative to the Icons 
		 or Icons. Additional folder under VC installation folder.
		Example: "UPM/pDroneTransportController"

properties.name: IconColor
properties.desc:
Fill color applied to the of the Icon in ARGB, RGB or unqualified-color-name 
		 format.
		(e.g. #FFFF0000 or #FF0000 or Red)

properties.name: IsSystem
properties.desc: Always returns False.

methods.name: signal
methods.desc:
Signals the current value of signal to all connected behaviors, 
		 thereby triggering the OnSignal event. 
		An optional value 
		 argument can be given to set the Value property of the signal.

properties.name: Value
properties.desc:
Defines the value of signal. 
		Setting this value does not trigger the 
		 OnSignal event unless you use the signal() method.

properties.name: getProperty
properties.desc:
Returns the first property matching a given name 
		 in report; otherwise returns None.

properties.name: publish
properties.desc: Saves the report as either an image, csv, Excel sheet or PDF.

properties.name: show
properties.desc: Shows the report.

methods.name: addBase
methods.desc: Adds a new base frame to controller.

methods.name: addTarget
methods.desc:
Adds a given motion target or target matrix to robot target 
		 list. 
		If target matrix, current settings of robot 
		 controller are used and an optional target_mode 
		 can be given to define how target relates to robot. This is similar 
		 to moveTo() method.
		Generally, you use addTarget() when you 
		 are creating a batch of targets and the robot will use non-zero 
		 accuracy limits.
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

methods.name: addTool
methods.desc: Adds a new tool frame to controller.

methods.name: clearTargets
methods.desc:
Removes all motion targets and target matrices from robot target 
		 list.

methods.name: createMotionInterpolator
methods.desc: Creates a new motion interpolator for robot.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.desc:
Create a new motion target using current controller settings, 
		 and then returns the new motion target. 
		An optional matrix 
		 argument can be given to define target matrix of target.

methods.name: move
methods.desc:
Moves robot to all targets in robot target list. 
		Python execution will wait until robot has 
		 motioned to all previously added targets.

methods.name: moveImmediate
methods.desc:
Moves robot to a given target immediately. 
		 
		An optional target_mode 
		 argument can be given to define how target relates to robot.
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.desc:
Moves robot to a given target or 
		 matrix, thereby clearing any previously 
		 added targets. 
		An optional target_mode 
		 argument can be given to define how target relates to robot.
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

methods.name: moveRelTo
methods.desc:
Moves robot to a position relative to current robot pose using 
		 current controller settings. 
		An optional target_mode 
		 argument can be given to define how target relates to robot.
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

methods.name: removeBase
methods.desc: Removes a given Base from controller.

methods.name: removeTool
methods.desc: Removes a given Tool from controller.

properties.name: ApproachAxis
properties.desc:
Defines how to orient the robot based on the orientation of 
		 the active tool frame.
		See Approach 
		 Axis Constants for more information.

properties.name: Bases
properties.desc: Gets a list of all base frames available in controller.

properties.name: ConfigurationMode
properties.desc:
Defines the configuration mode for joints driven by robot controller 
		 during linear motion interpolation. 
		0 = Fixed
		No change. That is, current configuration is used and does not 
		 change.
		1 = Follow frame
		Configuration closest to previous joint values is used.
		2 = Interpolate joint 
		 values
		Configuration is determined by point-to-point interpolation of 
		 joint values.
		See Motion 
		 Target Constants for more information.

properties.name: FlangeOffset
properties.desc:
Defines an offset from flange node origin. 
		Generally, this is used when flange node 
		 origin is not the exact place where to mount a tool or kinematics 
		 structure to end of robot arm.

properties.name: InitialBase
properties.desc: Defines the initial base frame by name of the controller.

properties.name: InitialTool
properties.desc: Defines the initial tool frame by name of the controller.

properties.name: Kinematics
properties.desc:
Defines the kinematics object used by the controller which 
		 describes the robot's kinematic structure.

properties.name: LagTime
properties.desc: If linear motion, defines default lag time.

properties.name: MaxAngularAccel
properties.desc:
If linear motion, defines maximum acceleration for angular 
		 movement (degrees/s^2).

properties.name: MaxAngularSpeed
properties.desc:
If linear motion, defines maximum speed for angular movement 
		 (degrees/s).

properties.name: MaxCartesianAccel
properties.desc:
If linear motion, defines maximum acceleration for linear movement 
		 (mm/s^2).

properties.name: MaxCartesianSpeed
properties.desc:
If linear motion, defines maximum speed for linear movement 
		 (mm/s).

properties.name: OrientationInterpolationMode
properties.desc: Defines the orientation interpolation mode for linear movement.

properties.name: RootOffset
properties.desc:
Defines an offset from root node origin, thereby defining the 
		 start of kinematics structure.

properties.name: SettleTime
properties.desc: If linear motion, defines default settle time.

properties.name: Tools
properties.desc: Gets a list of all tool frames available in controller.

properties.name: TrackWorldFrameMode
properties.desc:
Defines Robot World Frame (RWF) of robot when mounted on track. 
		 
		0
		Track origin is used as RWF.
		1
		RWF of robot is used as RWF.
		See Track 
		 World Frame Modes for more information.

properties.name: WorldTransformMatrix
properties.desc: Defines Robot World Frame of robot.

methods.name: createProperty
methods.desc:
Creates a new property of a given type 
		 and name in the routine, and then 
		 returns the new property. 
		An optional constraints 
		 argument can be used to define constraints for new property, which 
		 must be defined at the time of creation.
		See Property 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: deleteProperty
methods.desc:
Deletes a given property in the 
		 routine.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.desc:
Returns a property matching a given name 
		 in the routine; otherwise returns None.

properties.name: IsPersistent
properties.desc:
Defines if the routine is saved with the program. 
		The default value is True.

properties.desc: Defines the name of the routine.

properties.name: Program
properties.desc: Gets the program associated with the routine.

properties.name: Properties
properties.desc: Gets a list of properties in the routine.

methods.name: createConnector
methods.desc:
Adds a new connector in routing rule, and then returns the 
		 index of new connector.

methods.name: deleteConnector
methods.desc: Deletes a connector from routing rule at a given index.

methods.name: processRoute
methods.desc:
Returns the result of a routing test to verify if a given component would be routed based on a capacity 
		 test performed by a given behaviour 
		 or FlowProxy. 
		  
		Depending on the 
		 value of RuleComponent, the component 
		 can be either: 
		
			The arriving component (if RuleComponent == VC_ROUTING_PROCESSED)
			The owner component of the behavior (if RuleComponent == 
			 VC_ROUTING_OWNER)
		
		Returns -1 if no valid targets are found.

methods.name: setTarget
methods.desc:
Sets the connector by index for 
		 routing a component, which should be executed in OnRoute event.

properties.name: FlowProxy
properties.desc:
Defines if a proxy is used to check capacity of selected connector 
		 before routing a component.
		If None, this property is ignored.

properties.name: RuleComponent
properties.desc:
Defines the component used for rule processing.
		See Routing 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: Base
properties.desc: Defines the name of a base frame used by statement.

properties.name: CycleTime
properties.desc:
Defines the total elapsed time for executing motion statement, 
		 which may scale speed and acceleration of joints. 
		If zero, this property is ignored.

properties.name: ExternalTCP
properties.desc:
Defines the interpolation mode for targeting motion. 
		0 = False
		Default setting that uses Base to Tool configuration; position 
		 created at tool frame.
		1 = True
		Interpolation from Tool to Base; position created at base frame.

properties.name: Joint1 to JointN
properties.desc:
Defines the value of each joint driven by robot controller 
		 in statement.

properties.name: JointForce
properties.desc:
Defines the percentage of joint acceleration and deceleration 
		 values to use in statement.

properties.name: JointSpeed
properties.desc:
Defines the maximum speed for joints driven by robot controller 
		 as a percentage of nominal joint speed.

properties.name: MotionType
properties.desc:
Defines the motion type of statement. 
		0 = Joint
		1 = Linear
		See Motion 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: Synchronize
properties.desc:
Defines if joints driven by robot controller are synchronized 
		 to reach Target at CycleTime. 
		If False, robot might reach Target, and 
		 then wait for CycleTime to elapse until executing next statement.

properties.name: Target
properties.desc: Defines the position matrix of statement.

properties.name: Tool
properties.desc: Defines the name of tool frame used by statement.

		 function or one defined in Script.

Returns the object triggering an event in Script; otherwise

properties.name: Icon

Defines an icon for the process when referenced by a process

Adds a new property of a given type

		 which must be done at the time of creation.

methods.name: deleteProperty
methods.desc: Deletes a given property from statement.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.desc:
Returns the first property matching the given name 
		 in statement; otherwise returns None.

properties.desc: Defines the name of process to be executed by statement.

methods.name: callRemoteAction
methods.desc:
Schedules a remote routine by name in a connected robot to 
		 be executed at first opportunity. 
		Note: Python 
		 execution continues immediately.

methods.name: callRoutine
methods.desc:
Executes a routine by name in robot program, and then waits 
		 for completion of that routine. 
		An optional suspend 
		 argument can be used to wait or not wait for completion of routine. 
		 If False, Python execution continues immediately.

methods.name: createSubRoutine
methods.desc:
Adds a new routine of a given routine_name 
		 to robot program.

methods.name: delay
methods.desc:
Schedules a delay in the execution of robot program for a given 
		 amount of time. 
		Note: Python 
		 execution continues immediately.

methods.name: deleteProgram
methods.desc:
Deletes the robot program being handled by executor, thereby 
		 removing all routines and statements. 
		If deletion is successful, returns True; 
		 otherwise returns False.

methods.name: deleteSubRoutine
newProgram
methods.desc:
Creates a new robot program of a given name 
		 to be handled by executor.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.desc: Sets the value of a signal connected to a port at a given output_index in robot.

methods.name: waitInput
methods.desc:
Schedules the executor to wait until a signal connected to 
		 a port at a given input_index in robot 
		 has a given value. 
		Note: Python 
		 execution continues immediately.

methods.name: waitRemoteAction
methods.desc:
Schedules the executor to wait for completion of a routine 
		 by name in a connected robot. 
		Note: Python 
		 execution continues immediately.

properties.name: ActionMode
properties.desc:
Defines if the execution of robot program is performed automatically 
		 or by a logic controller, for example a pedestal. 
		If False, MainRoutine is executed automatically 
		 at start of simulation.

properties.name: Colour
properties.desc: Defines the color of robot program.

properties.name: Controller
properties.desc:
Defines the controller referenced by executor, which is either 
		 a controller for robot or servo.

properties.name: CurrentRoutine
properties.desc:
Gets the current routine in robot program being handled by 
		 executor.

properties.name: DigitalMapIn
properties.desc: Defines the input device used for reading digital signal values.

properties.name: DigitalMapOut
properties.desc: Defines the output device used for sending digital signal values.

properties.name: ExecutionMode
properties.desc:
Defines if a robot is controlled by an external executor, for 
		 example a virtual robot controller.

properties.name: IntegerMapIn
properties.desc: Defines the input device used for reading integer values.

properties.name: IntegerMapOut
properties.desc: Defines the output device used for sending integer values.

properties.name: Looping
properties.desc: Defines if the executor loops a robot program during a simulation.

properties.name: MainRoutine
properties.desc: Gets the main routine of robot program.

properties.name: ProcessHandlers
properties.desc:
Gets a list of all process statement handlers connected to 
		 executor.

properties.name: Program
properties.desc: Defines the URI of robot program being handled by executor.

properties.name: RealMapIn
properties.desc: Defines the device used for reading real number values.

properties.name: RealMapOut
properties.desc: Defines the device used for sending real number values.

properties.name: StringMapIn
properties.desc: Defines the device used for reading string values.

properties.name: StringMapOut
properties.desc: Defines the device used for sending string values.

properties.name: SubRoutines
properties.desc:
Gets a list of all subroutines in current robot program being 
		 handled by executor.

methods.name: beginBatch
methods.desc:
Disables the application's GUI to speed up the creation or 
		 edits for a batch of statements in routine.

methods.name: createStatement
methods.desc:
Adds a new statement of a given type 
		 to routine. 
		See Motion 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: deleteStatement
methods.desc:
Removes a statement at a given index 
		 from routine.

methods.name: endBatch
methods.desc:
Enables the application's GUI. 
		In most cases, this method is called after 
		 beginBatch().

methods.name: getStatement
methods.desc:
Returns a statement at a given index 
		 in routine.

properties.name: Program

properties.name: StatementCount
properties.desc: Gets the number of statements in routine.

properties.name: Statements
properties.desc: Gets a list of all statements in routine.

properties.name: GridColor
properties.desc:
Defines the color associated with the statement, for example 
		 when robot program is listed in a panel. 
		Color is defined in RGB color space by using 
		 a vector containing normalized XYZ values.

properties.name: Index
properties.desc: Defines the location (index) of statement in routine.

properties.name: Name
properties.desc: Defines the name of statement.

properties.name: Properties
properties.desc: Gets a list of all properties in statement.

properties.name: Routine
properties.desc: Gets the routine the statement belongs to in robot program.

properties.name: Type
properties.desc:
Gets the statement type. 
		See Motion 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: createChildQuantity
methods.desc:
Adds a new child quantity of a given name 
		 and type to the quantity.
		See Quantity Constants 
		 for more information.

methods.name: destroy
methods.desc:
If quantity is not built-in, destroys the quantity; otherwise 
		 throws an exception.

methods.name: getEffectiveUnit
methods.desc:
Returns a unit from effective unit group of quantity that 
		 closely matches a given magnitude.

properties.name: AvailableGroups
properties.desc:
Gets a list of all unit groups that include the quantity, thereby 
		 any one of those groups can be used to access and select quantity.

properties.name: Category
properties.desc:
If built-in quantity, gets category of quantity; otherwise 
		 defines the category of a quantity.

properties.name: Children
properties.desc:
Gets a list of all child quantities for the quantity.
		If no child quantities, value is empty list.

properties.name: CurrentGroup
properties.desc:
Defines the current unit group used for listing the quantity's 
		 properties.
		To set, give either a vcUnitGroup 
		 object or name of unit group.
		If value is None and quantity has a parent 
		 quality, uses the current group of parent.

properties.name: EffectiveGroup
properties.desc:
Gets the actual unit group used for listing the quantity's 
		 properties.
		If CurrentGroup is None, uses unit group 
		 of parent quantity.

properties.name: FullName
properties.desc:
Gets the full name of quantity, which is the concatenation 
		 of parent quantity names with a dot (.) separator and Name.
		You can refer to a quantity by referencing 
		 its full name.

properties.name: IsBuiltIn
properties.desc:
Indicates if quantity is a built-in quantity which cannot 
		 be edited nor destroyed.

properties.name: Name
properties.desc:
If quantity is built-in, gets name of quantity; otherwise 
		 defines the quantity's name.

properties.name: Parent
properties.desc:
If quantity is built-in, gets parent quantity; otherwise defines 
		 the parent of quantity.
		To set, give either a vcScalarQuantity 
		 object or full name of quantity.

properties.name: Type
properties.desc:
Gets the quantity type.
		See Quantity 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: addStatement
methods.desc:
Creates a new statement of a given type 
		 in the scope, and then returns that statement. 
		The default index 
		 value is -1 which adds the new statement to the end of the scope.
		An optional icon 
		 argument can be given to define the path of an icon used by the 
		 statement; otherwise the statement is given a default icon.
		See Statement 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: clear
methods.desc: Deletes all statements in the scope.

methods.name: deleteStatement
methods.desc:
Deletes a given statement in the 
		 scope.

methods.name: getStatement
methods.desc:
Returns a statement at a given index 
		 in the scope.

properties.name: ParentStatement
properties.desc:
Gets the statement that owns the scope, for example a conditional 
		 If or While statement that has a nested block of statements; otherwise 
		 the value is None for routines.

properties.name: Statements
properties.desc: Gets a list of statements belonging to the scope.

properties.name: Condition
properties.desc:
Defines an expression that when evaluated returns a True or 
		 False value. 
		A True value means the statement will execute 
		 its scope of statements and loop back, evaluating its condition 
		 before each iteration.
		A False value means the statement has been 
		 completed and will not execute its scope of statements.
		Note: In order 
		 to avoid an endless loop, use a condition that references a robot 
		 variable, port in robot, Break statement or a controller property.

properties.name: Scope
properties.desc: Gets the scope of statements executed by the statement.

methods.name: condition
methods.desc:
Delays the execution of script until a given function 
		 returns a True value or timeout 
		 period. 
		The first evaluation of the function is 
		 immediate, and then each subsequent test is triggered, for example, 
		 by signal connected to script. The default timeout 
		 period is zero.
		Returns a True value if condition is True 
		 before timeout, otherwise returns a False value.

methods.name: convertToByteCode
methods.desc:
Converts the code of script to bytecode. 
		Generally, this method is used to encrypt 
		 the code of script.

methods.name: delay
methods.desc: Delays the execution of script for a given amount of time.

methods.name: evaluateCondition
methods.desc:
Triggers the evaluation of an active condition() or triggerCondition() 
		 function in the script.

methods.name: getApplication

methods.name: getComponent
methods.desc: Returns the component of script.

methods.name: getNode

methods.name: getSimulation

methods.name: getTrigger
methods.desc:
Returns an object that acts as a trigger in script, for example 
		 a signal connected to script. 
		Generally, this method is called in a condition() 
		 or triggerCondition() expression to evaluate a trigger.

methods.name: resumeRun
methods.desc:
Resumes the execution of OnRun, the main program of script, 
		 that was placed in suspended state.

methods.name: suspendRun
methods.desc: Suspends the execution of OnRun, the main program of script.

methods.name: triggerCondition
methods.desc:
Delays the execution of script until a given function 
		 returns a True value or timeout 
		 period. 
		The evaluation of the function is triggered, 
		 for example, by signal connected to script. The default timeout period is zero.
		Returns a True value if condition is True 
		 before timeout, otherwise returns a False value.

methods.name: cancelPick
methods.desc: Cancels an active pick process.

methods.name: startPick
methods.desc:
Starts picking process, thereby allowing an interactive selection 
		 to occur.
		Process ends after first pick or by calling 
		 cancelPick() method.

properties.name: PickedNode
properties.desc:
Gets the node containing an object picked using startPick() 
		 method.

properties.name: PickedObject
properties.desc: Gets the object picked by command.

properties.name: PickedPrimitive
properties.desc:
Gets the geometry primitive of an object picked using startPick() 
		 method.

methods.name: addItem
methods.desc:
Adds a given item or an item 
		 in a given node to selection if item 
		 is a supported selection type. 
		See Selection 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: beginUpdate
methods.desc:
Blocks the application from doing update procedures while an 
		 item is being added to selection, thereby improving system performance. 
		 
		This method should be called before selecting 
		 any items.

methods.name: clear
methods.desc: Removes all items from selection.

methods.name: endUpdate
methods.desc:
Unblocks the application and sends a notification to update 
		 selection in scene. 
		This method should be called after the last 
		 item is added to selection.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.desc:
Returns a registered command matching a given name. 
		 
		The command should support the selection 
		 of an item, for example, Select, Translate, Rotate, Delete, Cut, 
		 Copy, and Paste.

methods.name: getItem
methods.desc:
Returns an item at a given index 
		 in selection.

methods.name: getItemNode
methods.desc:
Returns the node containing an item at a given index 
		 in selection.

methods.name: getItemWorldMatrix
methods.desc:
Returns the position matrix of an item at a given index 
		 in selection.

methods.name: registerCommand
methods.desc:
Registers a given command with 
		 selection and creates a command shortcut/menu item. 
		The name argument 
		 defines the name of command displayed in shortcut menu.
		An optional options argument can be given 
		 to enable command based on selection : when no objects are selected; 
		 a single object is selected; or multiple objects are selected.
		See Selection 
		 Constants of command type for more information or Examples 
		 section of this topic.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.desc:
Removes a given item or an item in a given node 
		 from selection.

properties.name: Count
properties.desc: Gets the number of items in selection.

properties.name: IgnoreEvents
properties.desc:
Defines if selection ignores event passing in order to avoid 
		 cyclic calls.

properties.name: Name
properties.desc: Gets the name of selection.

properties.name: Objects
properties.desc: Gets a list of all objects in selection.

properties.name: Type
properties.desc:
Gets the selection type. 
		See Selection 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: clear
properties.desc: Removes all objects from selection.

properties.name: getSelection
properties.desc:
Returns a list of objects of a given type 
		 that are in selection. 
		See Selection 
		 Constants for more information.

properties.name: setSelection
properties.access:
<Type> object, [Boolean append]
		or
		List of <Type> objects, 
		 [Boolean append]
properties.desc:
Creates a new selection for a given object 
		 or list of objects of a supported 
		 selection type. 
		An optional append 
		 argument can be used to retain current selection, thereby appending 
		 the given object(s) to that selection.
		See Selection 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.desc: Returns a property of the vcSequenceProcessConfiguration.

properties.name: ProcessGroup
properties.desc: The vcProcessGroup this configuration is applied to.

properties.name: IsLimitingVisits
properties.desc: Defines whether MaxVisitCountExpression is taken into use.

properties.name: MaxVisitCount
properties.desc: Defines how many times a vcProduct can visit this vcProcessGroup.

properties.name: Properties
properties.desc: Gets the properties of this vcSequenceProcessConfiguration.

methods.name: calcMotionTime
methods.desc:
Returns the calculated motion time of servo using current joint 
		 values and listed targets.

methods.name: createJoint
methods.desc:
Adds a new joint in servo. 
		(Deprecated)

methods.name: deleteJoint
methods.desc:
Removes a given joint or one at 
		 a given index from servo. 
		(Deprecated)

methods.name: findJoint
methods.desc:
Returns the first joint matching a given name in servo; otherwise 
		 returns None.

methods.name: getJoint
methods.desc: Returns a joint at a given index in servo.

methods.name: getJointTarget
methods.desc: Returns the target value of a joint at a given index in servo.

methods.name: getJointValue
methods.desc: Returns the current value of a joint at a given index in servo.

methods.name: move
methods.desc:
Drives all joints in servo to target values, and then returns 
		 the actual motion time. 
		Target values for each joint in servo can 
		 be given as separate, optional arguments.

methods.name: moveImmediate
methods.desc:
Drives all joints in servo to target values in zero simulation 
		 time. 
		Target values for each joint in servo can 
		 be given as separate, optional arguments.

methods.name: moveJoint
methods.desc:
Moves a joint at a given index in servo to a given value, and 
		 then returns the actual motion time.

methods.name: setJointTarget
methods.desc:
Sets the target value of a joint at a given index in servo 
		 to a given value.

methods.name: setMotionTime
methods.desc:
Forces the servo to execute joint movements at a given motion 
		 time.

properties.name: FlangeNode
properties.desc:
Defines the flange node of servo, for example the mount plate 
		 or carriage for other kinematic structures.

properties.name: HeartbeatTime
properties.desc:
If UseHeartbeat is set to True, defines the interval or pulse 
		 for updating joints.

properties.name: JointCount
properties.desc: Gets the number of joints in servo.

properties.name: Joints
properties.desc: Gets a list of all joints referenced by servo.

properties.name: RootNode
properties.desc:
Defines the root node of servo, thereby the fixed base of kinematic 
		 structure.

properties.name: Speed
properties.desc:
Defines joint speed as a percentage of maximum speed for driving 
		 joints in range 0 to 100.

properties.name: UseHeartbeat
properties.desc:
Turns on/off the use of a heartbeat or pulse to drive and update 
		 joints.

methods.name: connect
methods.desc:
Connects signals. The default value of the connect_in_gui 
		 is True, which means the created connection will be visible in 
		 GUI. 
		If a False value is given, the created connection 
		 won't be visible in GUI. Because of this, use the False value 
		 only when necessary!

methods.name: disconnect
methods.desc:
Disconnects signals. The default value of the disconnect_in_gui 
		 is True, which means the signal is disconnected also in GUI. 
		If the signals were connected using the 
		 connect method with a False argument 
		 in the connect_in_gui, they should 
		 be disconnected using a False argument in the disconnect_in_gui

properties.name: AutomaticReset
properties.desc:
Turns on/off the reset of signal to initial value when simulation 
		 is reset.

properties.name: Connections
properties.desc: Defines a list of behaviors connected to signal.

methods.name: canConnect
methods.desc:
Returns True if a given interface 
		 can connect to the interface; otherwise, returns False.

methods.name: connect
methods.desc:
Connects a given interface to the 
		 interface. 
		  
		An optional retain_offset 
		 argument can be used to retain the offset when attaching component 
		 to another using Hierarchy field. 
		  
		If connection is successful, returns True; otherwise 
		 returns False.

methods.name: createSection
methods.desc:
Adds a new section of a given name 
		 to interface, and then returns the new section.

methods.name: deleteSection
methods.desc:
If one-to-one interface, deletes a section at a given index 
		 from interface. 
		Returns True is deletion is successful; 
		 otherwise returns False.

methods.name: overrideEventResult
methods.desc: Overrides event result to have a given result.

methods.name: unConnect
methods.desc: (Deprecated) Use disconnect().

methods.name: disconnect
methods.desc:
Removes all connections in interface.
          An optional other_interface
          argument can be used to disconnect a specific interface from the
          interface, for example when interface is one-to-many.
          Returns True if disconnection is successful;
          otherwise returns None.

properties.name: AngleTolerance
properties.desc:
Defines an angle tolerance for allowing interfaces to connect 
		 to the interface when not aligned on same axis.

properties.name: ConnectedComponent
properties.desc:
Gets the component connected to interface. 
		If no connection, value is None.

properties.name: ConnectedComponents
properties.desc:
If one-to-many interface, gets a list of all components connected 
		 to interface. 
		If no connection, value is an empty list.

properties.name: ConnectedFromSections
properties.desc:
If one-to-many interface, gets a list of all sections in interface 
		 that have an active connection. 
		If no connection, value is an empty list.

properties.name: ConnectedSection
properties.desc:
If one-to-one interface, gets a section of interface that have 
		 an active connection. 
		(Deprecated)

properties.name: DistanceTolerance
properties.desc:
Defines the distance at which the interface snaps to an available 
		 connection, thereby completing Plug and Play.

properties.name: ConnectedSections
properties.desc:
If one-to-many interface, gets a list of all sections in interface 
		 that have an active connection. 
		(Deprecated)

properties.name: ConnectedToSections
properties.desc:
Gets a list of sections connected to interface. 
		If no connection, value is an empty list.

properties.name: ConnectionEditName
properties.desc:
Defines the name of a Button property to temporarily create 
		 in component for connecting the interface. 
		If an empty string, button is not created 
		 and/or removed from GUI. The string can use format [tab 
		 name]::[button name] to list button in a specific tab. 
		 If tab does not exist, it will be automatically created to contain 
		 button as long as string refers to that tab. If tab name is not 
		 given, button is listed as a default property.

properties.name: IsAbstract
properties.desc: Defines if interface supports remote connections.

properties.name: IsConnected
properties.desc:
If True, interface is connected; otherwise interface is not 
		 connected.

properties.name: Sections
properties.desc:
Gets a list of all sections in interface. 
		If no sections, value is an empty list.

properties.name: Index
properties.desc:
Defines the index of field in section. 
		Important: The 
		 order of fields in a section is evaluated when establishing a 
		 connection between sections. For example, sections may have compatible 
		 fields but cannot connect because the order of fields differ in 
		 each section.

properties.name: Name
properties.desc: Defines the name of field.

properties.name: Properties
properties.desc: Gets a list of all properties in the field.

properties.name: Section
properties.desc: Gets the section of field.

properties.name: Type
properties.desc:
Gets the field type. 
		See Interface 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: createField
methods.desc:
Creates a new field of a given type and name 
		 in section, and then returns the new field. 
		See Interface 
		 Constants for more information.

methods.name: deleteField

properties.name: ConnectedToSection
properties.desc:
Gets a section connected to the section. 
		If section is not connected, value is None.

properties.name: Fields
properties.desc: Gets a list of all fields in section.

properties.name: Frame
properties.desc:
If belonging to physical interface, defines the Frame feature 
		 referenced as the location of section.

properties.name: Index
properties.desc: Defines the index of section in interface.

properties.name: Interface
properties.desc: Gets the interface of section.

properties.name: Name
properties.desc: Defines the name of section.

methods.name: autoHalt
methods.desc:
Stops a simulation if there is no active component running 
		 a script that generates simulation events, and then returns True.

methods.name: continueRun
methods.desc:
Continues running a simulation with a 10 day runtime or a given 
		 amount of time.

methods.name: halt
methods.desc: Stops a simulation immediately.

methods.name: newCollisionDetector
methods.desc:
Creates a new collision detector in 3D world, and then returns 
		 the new detector.

methods.name: newVolumeDetector
methods.desc:
Creates a new volume detector in 3D world, and then returns 
		 the new detector.

methods.name: reset
methods.desc:
Resets simulation and static components to initial state and 
		 sets simulation clock at zero.

methods.name: restoreInitialState
methods.desc: Restores simulation and static components to initial state.

methods.name: run
methods.desc:
Runs simulation with a 10 day runtime or a given amount of 
		 time.

methods.name: setInitialState
methods.desc: Saves the current state of simulation and static components.

methods.name: setFastScheduling
methods.desc: Updates the fast scheduling flag for all conveyors that support the property.

methods.name: update
methods.desc:
Updates simulation and 3D world to reflect current state of 
		 components.

properties.name: IgnoreEvents
properties.desc:
Defines if simulation object ignores event passing in order 
		 to avoid cyclic calls.

properties.name: IsLooping
properties.desc:
Defines if the simulation gets automatically restarted when 
		 finished.

properties.name: IsRunning
properties.desc: Indicates if simulation is running in 3D world.

properties.name: Name
properties.desc: Gets the name of simulation object.

properties.name: ProcessController
properties.desc:
Gets the global process 
		 controller.

properties.name: SimSpeed
properties.desc: Defines the step size or speed of simulation.

properties.name: SimTime
properties.desc: Gets the current time (in seconds) of simulation.

properties.name: SimulationRunTime
properties.desc:
Defines a time (in seconds) when simulation should stop 
		 running. 
		Note: Changing the SimulationRunTime 
		 is only allowed in the OnRun event.

properties.name: SimWarmupTime
properties.desc: Defines a time (in seconds) of simulation warmup time.

properties.name: Statistics
properties.desc:
Gets the statistics manager of simulation used for defining 
		 intervals.

properties.name: World
properties.desc: Gets the simulation root node (3D world node).

methods.name: addControlPoint
methods.desc: Adds a given point to end of vehicle path.

methods.name: addOrientationPoint
methods.desc:
If Interpolation is not zero, adds a given vector 
		 to vehicle in order to calculate vehicle orientation at its last 
		 control point. 
		This method should be called immediately 
		 after adding control points to vehicle path. A given vector 
		 is not added to path.

methods.name: attachWagonAtTheEnd
methods.desc:
Attaches a given component to vehicle 
		 as a wagon. 
		If no previous wagons, component 
		 is added as lead wagon. Otherwise, component 
		 is attached to last wagon added to vehicle.
		An optional distance 
		 argument can be given to offset distance component 
		 is attached to vehicle. By default, the method will use distance 
		 of component to vehicle at time of call.

methods.name: calculateDecisionTimeToStopAt
methods.desc:
Returns the total simulation time at which vehicle would need 
		 to decelerate (decision point) to stop at a given distance 
		 in calculated motion path.

methods.name: calculateEnterExitBox
methods.desc:
Returns the distance at which vehicle would enter and exit 
		 a box based on calculated path, starting distance of vehicle and 
		 a given precision. 
		The Center, 
		 P1 and P2 
		 arguments define box.
		The returned distances will be within one-half 
		 of precision to the theoretical intersection.

methods.name: calculateFinishedTimeToStopAt
methods.desc:
Returns the calculated total simulation time that vehicle will 
		 stop at a given distance based on 
		 calculated path.

methods.name: calculateOffsetPathLength
methods.desc:
Returns the length of calculated path for vehicle based on 
		 a given offset.

methods.name: calculatePositionAt
methods.desc:
Returns the position and direction of vehicle at a given time based on calculated path. 
		If isElapsedTime 
		 argument is 0 (default), a given time 
		 is the elapsed time since start of vehicle movement. Otherwise, 
		 given time is elapsed time since start 
		 of simulation.

methods.name: calculatePositionWithDistance
methods.desc:
Returns the position of vehicle at a given distance 
		 in calculated path. 
		The returned value is a tuple in which first 
		 element is position vector.

methods.name: calculateSpeedAt
methods.desc:
Returns the speed of vehicle on calculated path at a given 
		 time. 
		If isElapsedTime 
		 argument is 0 (default), a given time 
		 is the elapsed time since start of vehicle movement. Otherwise, 
		 given time is elapsed time since start 
		 of simulation.

methods.name: calculateTravelWithTime
methods.desc:
Returns the distance traveled by vehicle on calculated path 
		 at a given time. 
		If isElapsedTime 
		 argument is 0 (default), a given time 
		 is the elapsed time since start of vehicle movement. Otherwise, 
		 given time is elapsed time since start 
		 of simulation.

methods.name: clearMove
methods.desc:
Removes all points from calculated path of vehicle, thereby 
		 stopping vehicle movement. 
		This method should be called at start of 
		 simulation before any control points are added to vehicle.

methods.name: clearPassedPoints
methods.desc:
Removes points from calculated path that have been reached 
		 by vehicle, thereby resetting the origin of calculated path and 
		 its length.

methods.name: detachAllWagons
methods.desc:
Detaches all wagons from vehicle and one another. 
		This method should be called when simulation 
		 is reset; otherwise components will remain attached to one another.

methods.name: getControlPointDistance
methods.desc:
Returns the distance of a control point at a given index in 
		 vehicle based on calculated path. 
		Note: If wagons 
		 are attached to vehicle, there will be control points with negative 
		 distances.

methods.name: offsetPath
methods.desc:
Offsets the calculated path of vehicle parametrically (X-axis 
		 is tangent, Y-axis is radial, Z-axis is up). 
		This method should be called after adding 
		 points to vehicle.

methods.name: rePlan
methods.desc:
Clears all points from vehicle except those between vehicle 
		 and its wagons, thereby allowing you to replan route of vehicle 
		 using current speed, position and orientation. That is, the vehicle 
		 will not stop rather reroute itself to newly added control points.

methods.name: resetStopAtDistance
methods.desc:
Instructs vehicle to stop at a given distance 
		 on calculated path. 
		This method allows you stop vehicle and 
		 recalculated route using same or different control points.

methods.name: rotateInPlace
methods.desc:
Rotates vehicle by a given angle 
		 using given angularSpeed, angularAcceleration 
		 and angularDeceleration arguments. 
		 
		Rotation will trigger OnMovementChanged 
		 and OnMovementFinished events. To ensure rotation is completed, 
		 use a delay, event or trigger before adding new control points 
		 to vehicle.

methods.name: update
methods.desc: Updates the position of objects controlled by vehicle.

properties.name: Acceleration
properties.desc:
Defines the maximum acceleration (mm/s^2) of vehicle. That 
		 is, how fast vehicle can speed up.

properties.name: Deceleration
properties.desc:
Defines the maximum deceleration (mm/s^2) of vehicle. That 
		 is, how fast vehicle can slow down.

properties.name: DecisionTime
properties.desc:
Gets the amount of time it will take vehicle to execute a movement 
		 and reach decision point of calculated motion path. 
		A decision point is the point at which vehicle 
		 will decelerate to stop at target. In some cases, a decision point 
		 is used to evaluate a vehicle and target location. For example, 
		 you may want to simulate vehicle routing and intersection crossing 
		 as well as evaluate if another vehicle is at target location.

properties.name: Interpolation
properties.desc:
Sets the tension (0 - n) of calculated motion path for vehicle 
		 to reach target. 
		(Optional) Default 
		 value is 0, which will result in straight lines from each waypoint 
		 of path. The bigger the value, the longer the vehicle will navigate 
		 along the tangents of waypoints.

properties.name: LengthIterations
properties.desc:
Sets the number of iterations for each path segment when calculating 
		 Bezier path length. 
		(Optional) Default 
		 value is 10. More iterations take longer to compute but give more 
		 precise results.

properties.name: MaxSpeed
properties.desc:
Defines the maximum speed (mm/s) of vehicle. That is, the top 
		 speed of vehicle.

properties.name: OffsetMatrix
properties.desc:
Sets an offset for vehicle origin and orientation. 
		(Optional) Default 
		 is containing node's origin. In some cases, you may want to retain 
		 orientation of vehicle when moving in reverse or along an elevated 
		 path.

properties.name: PathLength
properties.desc:
Gets the length of motion path vehicle will use to reach a 
		 target.

properties.name: TotalTime
properties.desc:
Gets the total travel time of vehicle to reach a target using 
		 calculated path.

methods.name: clear
methods.desc: Resets the command and clears its target data.

properties.name: Snap
properties.desc: Turns on or off the ability to snap to a target.

properties.name: SnapOnCircleCenter
properties.desc: Turns on or off the center of circles as potential targets.

properties.name: SnapOnCurve
properties.desc: Turns on or off curves as potential targets.

properties.name: SnapOnEdge
properties.desc: Turns on or off edges as potential targets.

properties.name: SnapOnEdgeCenter
